Upper Text: When this card would be played, if there are 2 or more suspended Digimon, reduce the cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend up to 2 Digimon. Then, none of your suspended [Vegetation] or [TS] trait Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon effects until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon suspend, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP until their turn ends for each suspended Digimon.
